title: Introducing the new DAO Financial Strategist Intern Team
body:
# **Introduction:**

We, the newly hired DAO Financial Strategist Interns, have written this post as our formal introduction to the Edgeware Community. As interns, we plan to start by getting familiar with the functioning and governance of the Edgeware community and then move onto perform the thorough analysis of the publicly owned Edgeware treasury. Finally, we plan to present our findings using appropriate models and tools to the community. Further, we were hired and on-boarded by the Agency, and will be working closely with them to present our deliverables.

Our team comprises two members, **Advait Rane** and **Vismay Joshi**, our detailed introduction is as follows:


## **Advait Rane**

I’m an Electrical Engineer and currently working with Accenture India as an Associate Software Developer. During the course of my graduation, I was part of various committees in prominent leadership roles. I have worked as a President of the EESA(Electrical Engineering Students Association) for a period of one academic year. This was a completely management-oriented role, where I learnt to manage multiple individuals. I was also managing the finances for the committee and was responsible for the budgeting, planning and documentation of the funds. 

Being from an Electrical Engineering background, I got the opportunity to work as an Intern in two of the major Electricity provider companies in India, i.e. Tata Power Co. Ltd. and Maharashtra State Electricity Board. During the course of these internships, I learnt about the financials required to set up the Electricity supply system for various kinds of consumers, depending on their respective requirements and more importantly worked with the Business Development Team for customer acquisition and consumer behaviour analysis. I also participated in a drive for the organisation which was targeted towards social awareness and customer acquisition.
